category: Headless table library for Svelte 5 — sorting, filtering, pagination, grouping, expansion, selection as plugins; zero styling opinions, fully accessible

competitors.note: The 800lb headless option; 28k+ stars, feature-broad (pinning, virtualization). Our nearest head-to-head on 'svelte headless table'.
Popular Svelte datatable with server-side/lazy mode; more batteries-included, less headless.
Long-standing simple Svelte table component; overlaps on the 'svelte table' head term.

non_goals: Styled/opinionated components (headless by design — no bundled CSS/theme)
Column/row pinning and built-in virtualization (TanStack covers these; documented patterns instead)

page_validation._comment: compare-data.ts drives six /compare pages: vs-tanstack-table, vs-vincjo-datatables, vs-svelte-table, vs-flowbite-svelte-datatable, vs-ag-grid, vs-handsontable. Validator checks framework/Svelte-5 claims, hardcoded stars/download figures (e.g. TanStack '28k+'), and them: feature cells on competitor version bumps.

repo_triage._comment: Public repo — GITHUB_TOKEN raises rate limits; public-read fallback works without it. Surfaces open PRs/issues NOT opened by github_handle, and threads awaiting your reply since the previous last_run.

self_features: Headless — you own 100% of the markup/styling; it manages state, not UI
Plugin architecture: sort, column + global filter, pagination, addGroupBy, addExpandedRows + addSubRows, addSelectedRows, addResizedColumns, addColumnOrder, addHiddenColumns
Continuation/maintained successor to the original svelte-headless-table

seo._comment: 3 keywords in Ahrefs rank tracker (project 8934906). Head terms: 'svelte headless table', 'svelte table', 'svelte data table', 'svelte datagrid'. Drop a GSC export into .competitive-intel/gsc/ when available.

watchlist.note: The ORIGINAL namesake (Bryan Lee), now largely dormant — this package is its Svelte 5 continuation. Watch for any upstream revival.
Enterprise JS grid; covered on the /compare page. Different weight class but ranks for 'data grid'.
Spreadsheet-grid; /compare rival for the 'data grid / editable table' intent.
